name: Moshimo Elf to Orc ga Iru Isekai ni Itte Shimattara
original_name: もしもエルフとオークがいる異世界に行ってしまったら
source:
Restore the true relationship between elves and orcs with special reincarnation benefits for the lower body!

You have been reincarnated in another world with a fig leaf pasted on the crotch.

There is a vast forest where elves and orcs live.

However, it was a world where the relationship between elves and orcs felt strange.

You was mistaken for an orc and was captured by an elf, and while being pressed by the orc queen, he was reminded of the mission of "correcting the world" that remained in his memory.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ435262.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
凭借专门强化下半身的转生福利，修复精灵与兽人之间真正的关系！

你转生到了异世界，胯下还贴着一片无花果叶。

这里有一片广阔森林，精灵与兽人共同生活其中。

然而，这个世界里精灵和兽人之间的关系似乎不太对劲。

你被误认成兽人而遭精灵抓获，又被兽人女王压在身下；这时，你想起了残留在记忆中的“纠正世界”使命。
